title: 🏹 सम्पूर्ण रामायण (Sampoorna Ramayan) in 5 Minutes | Sacred Musical Journey | 1080p Full HD
description:
॥ श्रीरामचन्द्राय नमः ॥
Experience the sacred epic of the Ramayana from start to finish in 5 celestial minutes, accompanied by the timeless divine musical hymn 'मंगल भवन अमंगल हारी' (Mangal Bhavan Amangal Hari).

📖 THE 7 SACRED KANDAS OF RAMAYANA:
✦ 00:00 • बालकाण्ड (Bala Kanda): Avatar descent of Sri Rama in Ayodhya, Vishvamitra Yajna, breaking of Shiva Pinaka bow & Sita-Rama Kalyanam.
✦ 00:55 • अयोध्याकाण्ड (Ayodhya Kanda): Dasharatha's word, Kaikeyi's boons, Lord Rama accepting 14-year Vanavasa with tranquil smiling grace.
✦ 01:30 • अरण्यकाण्ड (Aranya Kanda): Panchavati hermitage, golden deer Maricha, Sita Harana & supreme valorous sacrifice of Bird King Jatayu.
✦ 02:15 • किष्किन्धाकाण्ड (Kishkindha Kanda): Divine union of Lord Rama and Hanuman on Rishyamukha mountain, alliance with Sugriva.
✦ 02:55 • सुन्दरकाण्ड (Sundara Kanda): Mahabali Hanuman's mighty leap across the ocean, Ashoka Vatika darshan, Sri Rama Mudrika & Lanka Dahan.
✦ 03:40 • युद्धकाण्ड (Yuddha Kanda): Miracle of floating Rama Setu bridge, battle of Lanka, fall of Kumbhakarna & Lord Rama slaying Ravana with Brahmastra.
✦ 04:35 • उत्तरकाण्ड & श्रीराम पट्टाभिषेकम् (Uttara Kanda & Coronation): Return to Ayodhya in Pushpaka Vimana, the glorious coronation of Sri Rama, and dawn of eternal Ram Rajya.

॥ श्रीराम स्तुति ॥
श्रीरामचन्द्र कृपालु भजु मन हरण भवभय दारुणम् ।
नवकञ्जलोचन कञ्जमुख करकञ्ज पद कञ्जारुणम् ॥

Chant with devotion:
॥ जय सिया राम ॥ | ॥ ॐ रां रामाय नमः ॥ | Jai Shri Ram 🏹
